cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

mechanism: A dictates a small preliminary commitment whose consequences will pull B into the larger undecided risk.
confusable: Distinguish explaining a plan from inducing a real initial consequence before agreement to the main action.
comparison: Deposit creates financial and attendance pressure; public festival announcement creates a date and reputational expectation.
seedUse: Use canonical climbing and festival seeds; retain their backward commitment logic but replace abstract closing advice with a concrete next demand under S01.
